1. (Currently amended) A method for providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the method comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information and the associated recipient data; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via __over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the electronic value certificate data is not transmitted as a transitory signal__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an __Short Message Service (SMS)__ message containing a __Uniform Resource Locator (URL)__ link to a web page displaying a barcode.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control __Short Message Service (SMS)__ message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein establishing a communications link with a mobile device comprises: sending a control __short message service (SMS)__ message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data; and receiving, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data.

13. (Currently amended) A system for electronically providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data __that includes at least one of: a certificate authorization code, personalization data, or a control message__; and an __over the air (OTA)__ provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via __over the air (OTA)__ communications, __wherein the provisioning server stores the electronic value certificate data in non-transitory storage on the mobile device__.
